sections.label: SSG and WSG coordination gaps
sections.summary: The passage asks what specific coordination gaps or overlaps remain if SSG and WSG have largely achieved their objectives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: If SSG and WSG have largely achieved their intended objectives, then what specific coordination gaps or overlaps remain today?

sections.label: Clause 5(3) no enforceable duty
sections.summary: Clause 5(3) makes clear that these functions do not create an enforceable duty.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Clause 5(3) makes clear that these functions do not create an enforceable duty.

sections.label: Place-and-train model question
sections.summary: The passage asks whether to move towards a place-and-train model where employment is secured upfront and training follows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: More fundamentally, should we move decisively towards a place-and-train model, where employment is secured upfront and training follows rather than asking residents to train first without a clear job pathway?

sections.label: No wrong door commitment
sections.summary: The passage asks why there is no explicit 'no wrong door' commitment if the intention is seamless service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: If the intention is seamless service, why is there no explicit "no wrong door" commitment?

sections.label: Training outcomes and industry alignment
sections.summary: The passage asks whether SWDA will track training-to-job outcomes, assess providers on placement, wages and retention, and align curricula with industry demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: A course that is completed but does not improve employability is not a success.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Hence, will SWDA track whether training actually leads to jobs?

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Will providers be assessed based on placement rates, wage outcomes and retention?

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: What mechanisms will SWDA put in place to ensure that training curricula of its funded courses are tightly aligned with industry demand and not lagging behind it?

sections.label: Outcome-based reporting and funding
sections.summary: The speaker suggests outcome-based reporting by programme type, disclosure of placement and wage outcomes, and funding tied to sustained employment rather than completion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: To strengthen this pillar, I suggest first, having outcome-based reporting by programme type; second, disclosure of placement and wage outcomes; and third, funding tied to sustained employment, not just completion.

sections.label: SSG and WSG collaboration
sections.summary: SSG and WSG collaborate under different Agencies, and the speaker asks what new thrusts the SWDA's clause 5 functions add beyond existing Acts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Even after they were housed under different Agencies, SSG and WSG, they collaborate to work together to build a robust and integrated jobs and skills ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: So, when we look at the functions of the new SWDA under clause 5 of the Bill, what are the new thrusts that go beyond the existing functions in the SkillsFuture Singapore Agency Act 2016 and in the Workforce Singapore Agency Act 2003?

sections.label: Cost of merging agencies
sections.summary: The passage asks what the estimated costs are of bringing SSG and WSG together as one SWDA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: What are the estimated costs of bringing the SSG and WSG together as one SWDA?

sections.label: SWDA board membership size
sections.summary: Clause 9 of the Bill provides that the new SWDA will consist of seven to 15 members.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Clause 9 of the Bill provides that the new SWDA will consist of seven to 15 members.

sections.label: SWDA jointly overseen by MOM and MOE
sections.summary: The Prime Minister's Budget 2026 speech announced the new SWDA will be jointly overseen by MOM and MOE, as some Members mentioned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The Prime Minister's Budget 2026 speech also announced that the new SWDA will be jointly overseen by the MOM and the MOE, some of the Members before me have already mentioned this.

sections.label: SWDA role in curriculum design
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether SWDA will feed real-time industry insights into curriculum development so course content, modules and skill pathways can be refreshed more frequently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Today, the pace of change in areas, such as AI, advanced manufacturing and digital services, is accelerating.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Skills that are relevant today may become outdated within just a few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: While our institutions have done well to update programmes periodically, there may be scope to move towards a more dynamic and iterative model of curriculum design.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: For instance, could the Minister elaborate on whether SWDA will play a more active role in feeding real-time industry insights into curriculum development, so that the course content, modules and skill pathways can be refreshed more frequently and responsively?

sections.label: NTUC survey on career changes
sections.summary: An NTUC survey found more than three in four workers expect to make career changes in their lifetime.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: Based on an NTUC survey, more than three in four workers expect to make career changes in their lifetime.

sections.label: New SWDA under one roof
sections.summary: The new SWDA seeks to change this by bringing everything under one roof.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: The new SWDA seeks to change this by bringing everything under one roof.

sections.label: Broken rung area of attention
sections.summary: One area deserving close attention is what some call the broken rung, which the speaker raised in the Budget speech.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: One area that deserves close attention is what some have called the broken rung, something I spoke about during my Budget speech.

sections.label: Training providers and Tripartite Jobs Council
sections.summary: Training providers helped turn broad ambition into practical capability, and the Tripartite Jobs Council was announced on May Day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: Training providers helped turn broad ambition to practical capability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: We recently announced the Tripartite Jobs Council on May Day.

sections.label: NTUC scaling up AI career coach
sections.summary: NTUC can scale up its AI career coach, which has over 9,000 sign-ups and gives 24/7 help to young people entering the workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: Second, NTUC can scale up our AI career coach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: This tool has already seen over 9,000 sign-ups, providing 24/7 help to young people as they take first steps into the workforce.

sections.label: Tech Talent Academy training numbers
sections.summary: Since 2024 the Tech Talent Academy trained over 53,000 workers, about 4,000 through the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme, with over half already employed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: Since 2024, the Tech Talent Academy has trained over 53,000 workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: About 4,000 of these were people switching careers through the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo)
sentences.text: More than half of them have already found jobs in a softening job market.

sections.label: 2016 SSG and WSG restructuring
sections.summary: The 2016 restructuring let SSG and WSG develop specialised capabilities in adult training and employment facilitation respectively.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The restructuring in 2016 allowed SSG and WSG to develop specialised capabilities in adult training and employment facilitation respectively.

sections.label: Merger decision and changed facts
sections.summary: The merger is right today because AI, technology and geopolitical disruptions have significantly changed the operating reality.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As for why the merger is the right decision today, let me quote John Maynard Keynes, which is the father of macroeconomics, "When the facts change, I change my mind." Members of the House, with the rapid advances in AI, with technology disruptions happening at a rapid pace and mounting geopolitical disruptions, our operating reality has changed significantly – and so must we.

sections.label: SWDA expanded ecosystem mandate
sections.summary: SWDA has an expanded mandate to develop Singapore's broader career employment and training ecosystem and improve access to quality services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: It also requires a greater variety, a greater volume of services to meet the ever more complex and diverse needs of workers and their employers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, hence, in addition to delivering better services and programmes, SWDA has an expanded mandate to develop the broader career employment and training ecosystem in Singapore, supporting innovative solutions and improving access to quality services.

sections.label: SWDA reporting to two Ministries
sections.summary: MOM will be SWDA's parent Ministry, with joint oversight with MOE aligning IHLs with the workforce agenda.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To address Ms He Ting Ru's question on how SWDA might manage the reporting relationship to two Ministries, MOM will be the parent Ministry of SWDA, but the joint oversight arrangement with MOE, that means between myself and Minister Desmond Lee, will bring the IHLs into closer alignment with our workforce agenda, ensuring that skills development is pursued in a coherent way.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit funding scope
sections.summary: Government course fee funding applies only to industry-relevant courses, and mid-career SkillsFuture Credit is scoped to stricter employability criteria.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: While the base tier of SkillsFuture Credit is applicable to a wide range of courses, including those for personal interests, Government funding for course fees is only applicable for courses that offer skills relevant to that specific industry, which will support the workforce's upskilling needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The additional SkillsFuture Credit for mid-careerists is further scoped to courses that meet more stringent criteria on employability outcomes and industry relevance.

sections.label: SWDA, IHLs and MOE industry exposure
sections.summary: SWDA will work with IHLs and MOE to bring industry exposure upstream so students know the labour market before graduating.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: SWDA will work with IHLs and MOE to bring industry exposure upstream so that our students can have a clearer picture of the labour market well before they graduate.

sections.label: Career guidance and course funding
sections.summary: Career guidance services will be made more accessible and course funding tied more closely to demand signals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will make good quality career guidance services more accessible to the broad middle of workers and equip them with data-driven insights on jobs and skills so that they can undertake the right training that connects them to the opportunities that they are seeking.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will look at tying course funding more closely to demand signals so that training translates into better career prospects.

sections.label: MyCareersFuture job postings target
sections.summary: Over 60,000 job postings are on MyCareersFuture, with an aspiration to reach 100,000 in 12 months from SWDA's establishment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, there are already over 60,000 job postings published on MyCareersFuture.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We aspire to reach 100,000 job postings in 12 months from SWDA's establishment.

sections.label: Verified credentials shortlisting likelihood
sections.summary: Applicants with verified credentials are 1.5 times more likely to be shortlisted by hirers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Applicants with verified credentials are 1.5 times more likely to be shortlisted by hirers.

sections.label: Company Training Committee initiative
sections.summary: NTUC is spearheading the Company Training Committee initiative, involving $300 million funding to drive enterprise and workforce transformation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: NTUC is spearheading the Company Training Committee initiative, which involves $300 million funding to drive enterprise and workforce transformation.

sections.label: Anchor programme partners appointed
sections.summary: The Singapore Business Federation and SNEF have been appointed as anchor programme partners for the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Singapore Business Federation and SNEF, for example, have already been appointed as anchor programme partners for the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package.

sections.label: Tripartite Jobs Council set-up
sections.summary: A Tripartite Jobs Council co-chaired by NTUC, SNEF and MOM was set up to address challenges and opportunities brought by AI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: NTUC and SNEF and their networks – they have and they are formidable resources – and SWDA will leverage with their resources, their network, to intervene more decisively ahead of upcoming disruptions or downturns.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This is also why we recently announced, just last week, on Friday, the set-up of a Tripartite Jobs Council, co-chaired by NTUC, SNEF and MOM to bring our collective capabilities to bear on the challenges and the opportunities brought by AI.

sections.label: SWDA job placement goals
sections.summary: SWDA's goal is helping Singaporeans enter good jobs, measured by time to placement, wage growth, training and placement numbers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For individuals, our ultimate goal is to help Singaporeans enter into good jobs and progress in their careers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will measure SWDA's effectiveness in doing so through indicators, such as time to placement and wage growth, in addition to training and placement numbers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For example, about nine in 10 Career Conversion Programme participants remain employed 24 months after embarking on the programme, and about six in 10 of those who participated in these Career Conversion Programmes earn more than their last drawn salaries.

sections.label: Board draws diverse backgrounds
sections.summary: The Board will draw from public sector, business leaders and partners such as NTUC, SNEF and trade associations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Board will draw from diverse backgrounds – public sector representatives, senior business leaders from multinational corporations and local enterprises across different sectors and key partners, such as NTUC, SNEF and the trade associations and chambers.

sections.label: Transition of existing schemes
sections.summary: SSG's and WSG's operations will be fully undertaken by SWDA from Day One, with commitments honoured and programmes rationalised over time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Mr Mark Lee, Ms Elysa Chen, Ms Jessica Tan and Mr Saktiandi Supaat have asked about the impact of the transition on existing schemes, applications and commitments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I would like assure Members that SSG's and WSG's operations will be fully undertaken by SWDA from Day One.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will ensure uninterrupted service delivery and the existing grant and employment assistance commitments will be honoured.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To the concerns raised by Mr Mark Lee, Mr Shawn Loh and Ms Yeo Wan Ling about potential overlaps, over time, we will work to rationalise programmes and streamline touchpoints to simplify the user journey.

sections.label: Polytechnics present lifelong learning awards
sections.summary: Lianhe Zaobao reported five polytechnics presented SkillsFuture Lifelong Learning Awards to 15 recipients, including two over 50.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, Lianhe Zaobao reported that five polytechnics presented the SkillsFuture Lifelong Learning Awards to a total of 15 recipients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: This included two individuals aged over 50 among them – Mr Wang Boyu Peter and Ms Serene Soh Sze-Mei.

sections.label: Merger of WSG and SSG
sections.summary: The merger of WSG and SSG will combine both agencies' strengths, and SWDA's establishment is a milestone in human capital development.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The merger of WSG and SSG will combine the strengths of both agencies, providing Singaporeans and employers with more comprehensive and effective support.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The establishment of SWDA will be an important milestone in our nation's human capital development.

sections.label: Training investment improves retention
sections.summary: Companies investing in worker training through Company Training Committees, job redesign or Career Conversion Programmes have seen better employee retention.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Companies that invest in the training of their workers, whether they work through the NTUC Company Training Committees or they work through our job redesign package, work through WSG's Career Conversion Programmes, have seen better retention for their employees.

sections.label: SWDA uses MOM labour data
sections.summary: SWDA will leverage on MOM's labour data.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, SWDA will leverage on MOM's labour data.

sections.label: Career and Skills Passports mapping
sections.summary: Career and Skills Passports with recorded skills can be mapped more precisely to sectoral skills frameworks for differentiated matching.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: On top of that, the Career and Skills Passports with the skills that have been recorded can be more precisely mapped to the different sectoral skills framework to allow for a more differentiated, a more precise matching.

sections.label: SWDA integrated intelligence function
sections.summary: SWDA's integrated intelligence function will provide forward-looking signals on roles and skillsets in demand, helping IHL students and families decide.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Secretary-General will be able to provide that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But suffice to say, to further add on to your other colleague, Mr Giam's earlier point, the SWDA's integrated intelligence function will provide forward-looking signals on what roles and what skillsets are in demand, so then this will allow students and even their families in the IHLs to make more informed decisions.

sections.label: Mindset change and Career Health SG
sections.summary: Success requires mindset change; Career Health SG encourages residents to take interest in their own career health and update training.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Core to the success of this entire exercise requires mindset change – and I did make that a very clear point when I first started my speech.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have, over the past few years, rolled out many initiatives, including Career Health SG.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The case we exhort, we encourage all of our Singapore residents to do is to really take an interest in their own career health, going into their own Career Health to update their own training and look at what are the adjacencies in terms of the skills training that will be required to keep up with the latest development in the industry and economic development.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: When they continue to keep up, our portal will also be able to push courses to them, because we would have triangulated from trade associations and chambers, from the employers, from industry as to how the industry is moving, in what directions they are moving.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Regardless of what we do, some sectors will face a sunset phase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And for them, this would then allow them to decide whether they want to upgrade themselves in a different industry, allow them to pivot across.
